title: 验证预算
body: 除请求中强制执行的 `node --test` 外，是否运行一项额外的可选保障？推荐跳过以保持紧凑；若运行，将执行现有项目检查器覆盖的额外回归/完整测试范围，预计增加约 1 个工作单元的时间与少量令牌。

title: Verification budget
body: Beyond the mandatory real-project `node --test` run and the required workflow checks, should I run one additional independent integrity review of the final change? Recommended: skip optional testing for the compact path. Running it adds a separate review pass and modest extra time/tokens.
